title: Palm Beach State College and FAU Activate First Operational Segment of Florida’s Statewide Quantum-Safe Network - Quantum Computing Report
gist: Palm Beach State College and Florida Atlantic University activated the first live link of Florida's statewide quantum-safe network, using IonQ QKD hardware over Palm Beach County dark fiber, funded by a $1M FloridaCommerce defense infrastructure grant. It is the first milestone of an IonQ-Florida LambdaRail Master Service Agreement envisioning a ~100-mile Palm Beach-to-Miami-Dade corridor, with more nodes due within three months, alongside PBSC quantum workforce programs.

themes.theme: First live link of Florida quantum-safe network

insights.claim: PBSC and FAU activated the first operational link of Florida's statewide quantum-safe network, connecting PBSC's West Palm Beach campus to FAU's Boca Raton campus over Palm Beach County dark fiber.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: A live deployment, not a pilot announcement; adds to IonQ's networking reference sites.
insights.locator: Palm Beach State College (PBSC) and Florida

insights.claim: The link uses IonQ's QKD hardware and key-management software to protect academic, scientific and healthcare data against eavesdropping and harvest-now-decrypt-later threats, funded by a $1 million FloridaCommerce defense infrastructure grant with Florida LambdaRail and Palm Beach County as partners.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: IonQ's networking segment is winning state-funded deployments; contract sizes remain small.
insights.quote: Supported by a $1 million defense infrastructure grant from FloridaCommerce

insights.claim: The link is the first milestone of a Master Service Agreement between IonQ and Florida LambdaRail signed at eMerge Americas 2026, envisioning a continuous quantum-safe corridor of nearly 100 miles from Palm Beach County to Miami-Dade County.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: MSA structure implies follow-on revenue for IonQ as nodes are lit.
insights.locator: The operational link marks the inaugural

insights.claim: Within three months the consortium plans to light nodes at Miami Dade College and FAU's Jupiter campus, securing data links among biomedical research sites including the Herbert Wertheim UF Scripps Institute and the Max Planck Florida Institute for Neuroscience.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
entities: Max Planck Florida Institute for Neuroscience
insights.so_what: Near-term, checkable milestone for IonQ's networking execution.

insights.claim: Florida LambdaRail's 1,540-mile backbone is positioned as the foundation to scale QKD across 13 member universities statewide.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Large addressable footprint for statewide QKD if funding continues.

insights.claim: PBSC's forthcoming Quantum Innovation Center has secured nearly $7 million, and the college will launch a Quantum Systems Certification Program in Spring 2027 and a two-year Associate in Science in quantum technology with a pathway into FAU degrees.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Technician-level training addresses a hardware deployment labor bottleneck for quantum networking.
